facts.fact: Tchadinfos reports a ministry delegation inspected construction of the technical sites and fibre installation of the Trans-Saharan Backbone (DTS), which links Chad to the Mediterranean network via Niger; works launched in 2023 are slowed, and vandalism was found at the Bol site.
Tchadinfos reports the DTS project has European Union financing of 29 million euros, and that its works began in 2023.
